text:
lina: Hey—noticed a weird divergence on the latency dashboard: /v1/generate p50 flat, p95 +18ms, p99 +140ms around 08:02 UTC. Looks endpoint-scoped.

mike: I saw that. We nudged routing weights for eu-west yesterday but that shouldn't just hit p99. Did you slice by client_tag?

lina: yes—spike concentrated on client_tag=mobile-ios and queue=high-priority. Screenshot in the console.

sangeet: telemetry question: do we currently surface 'sample_origin' on samples? If not, we can't tell gateway vs backend.

mike: we don't consistently tag origin; some shards emit gateway_total_ms, others backend_proc_ms and console rolled up service_time_ms without origin. Bad mix.

devx: UX proposal: add a metric-legend on the latency pane that shows the metric used (gateway_total / backend_proc / combined) and a small toggle "include queue time" default off. Hover text explains impact.

ashley: mobile canary drove a bump—could be transient queue burst. ops-bot, any autoscaler events?

ops-bot: Autoscaler: scaled +2 workers eu-west-1 at 07:58 UTC due to cpu_util spike.

lina: scaling after the spike matches capacity knee. Action suggestions: (1) infra: add sample_origin + queue_time_ms fields; (2) console: default to backend_proc_ms for pXX until provenance available; (3) devx: add legend/toggle + provenance pill; (4) alerts: add runbook step to inspect queue_time_histogram when route p99 exceeds baseline.

sangeet: I'll submit a PR to add origin and queue_time fields today. Will announce.

mike: I'll run a raw-sample compare to post backend_proc_ms p99 vs gateway_total_ms p99 for that 15m window and upload results.

devx: once origin exists, console can show a "provenance" pill and link to raw-sample view for SE debugging. Also add unit tests for toggle behavior.

lina: great, thanks. I'll follow up on the Console UX board. :thumbsup:
